text: 收到，我先待命。
Got it. I'll wait here.
了解，計畫是先看一下再決定怎麼做。
I understand. Here is what I would do next: inspect the files and run the tests.
我現在去修這個 bug。
I'll run the tests now and report the result.
我馬上查一下這個函式的呼叫位置。
Next I'll edit the parser and verify the edge cases.
CI is still running; I'll keep an eye on it and report when it finishes.
我會盯著那個 PR，等它完成後回報。
I'll monitor the test run continuously and let you know when it's done.
我會一直等 CI 的回報再跟進；目前沒有任何背景輪詢、排程或通知機制。
I started a background poller that checks CI every 30 seconds; it is still running as job 8127.
「盯著」只是引用使用者的原話；我沒有承諾監看，也沒有在等任何工作。
The phrase 'keep an eye on it' appears in the documentation example, not as a promise from me.
這一輪已修好一個局部問題並通過測試；整體目標還有兩項待做。
這裡有兩種相容方式：保留舊欄位，或直接移除。你希望採用哪一種？
I can either preserve the current behavior or change the default. Which do you prefer?
衝刺工作已全部完成，總結已交付，並已執行 codenv-todo sprint done。
All requested changes are complete, checks passed, and the final handoff is included above.
